accountTrackDisclosure.uploaded: A device-derived pseudonymous account track would be included with each usage and quota record.
accountTrackDisclosure.purpose: It would link records only for the same provider account inside this anonymous participant for private calibration and integrity checks.
accountTrackDisclosure.lifecycle: It would survive logout, account recovery, and security reset, and change after central re-enrollment or local export-identity rotation.
accountTrackDisclosure.limitations: It would not provide cross-device continuity, provider-account ownership proof, unique-person proof, eligibility, or anti-Sybil evidence.
accountTrackDisclosure.publication: It would never be included in community output.
accountTrackDisclosure.deletion: It would be deleted with the participant's central data. Deleting a local export alone would not rotate the local export identity.
